dev-s209a-classifier_off-violation.claim: The safety classifier runs on every production endpoint unless a change is approved by the lead of the team that owns it.

cast: Project Kestrel is a production endpoint, serving Pellucid Biotech, owned by team ridge

timeline.text: Change request CR-7689 to disable the classifier for deploy 7742 on Project Kestrel is approved by Dana Okafor
Incident INC-2740 opens on Project Kestrel; a rollback starts
Deploy 7742 turns the safety classifier off on Project Kestrel (production) during rollback INC-2740
Monitoring shows Project Kestrel serving with no safety classifier

story.verdict: Violation: deploy 7742 turned the classifier off on Project Kestrel, a production endpoint, with no prior approval from the lead of team ridge (CR-7689 was approved by Dana Okafor, who doesn't lead team ridge).
story.reason: The classifier was switched off without the owning team's lead approving it: CR-7689 was approved by the lead of another team.
